title: XDMOD test run record (version 1)
description: One test run (HIL or simulation), kept on the orphan branch `evidence` of robarm-integration (D57, D73) as runs/<YYYY>/<run id>/record.json. Written by `curatrix evidence record`, read into TR needs by `curatrix evidence read`. Evidence rule: D60 (clean tree, pinned versions, only commits on main or a baseline tag); validity: D131 (SHAs must match the current pins, else stale). Documented in xdmod/curatrix/README.md, section 'Evidence'.

run_id.description: <UTC time>-<8 hex>; the 8 hex digits are the first 8 of sha256(firmware sha256 + manifest SHA + created). They become the suffix of every TR ID of this run.

kind.description: hil = on the hardware setup (method hil, R5 applies); sim = native_sim/QEMU (method test). A sim record is never HIL evidence.

recorded_by.description: git user.name of whoever ran the writer (person or agent).

config.description: The single SYS-CFG the run was made on (D103).

setup.description: HIL setup folder hil/<setup> in robarm-integration (hil runs).

platform.description: Zephyr board target, e.g. nucleo_g474re or native_sim/native.

file.description: Path of the image relative to the Twister output dir (zephyr.bin for hardware, zephyr.exe for native_sim).

repos.description: Every west project of the workspace (all pinned repos: xdmod, robarm-*, Zephyr, modules, tools, libraries), by west name.

ok.description: The evidence rule held when the run was recorded (D60). The writer refuses to write to the evidence branch otherwise.

base.description: What the run counts against: 'main' or a baseline tag 'baseline/vX.Y.Z' of the manifest.

test.description: Twister test case identifier, e.g. robarm.smoke.robarm_smoke.runs.

test_case.description: The traced test case (SW-TC, INT-ITC, INT-STC, EE-TC, ME-TC) from the comment above the ZTEST (D80), or null if the test verifies nothing (no TR is made).

files.description: sha256 of the Twister reports stored next to record.json.

pin.description: The manifest revision (west manifest-rev); equals sha under the evidence rule.

on.description: Where the commit is: 'main', 'baseline/vX.Y.Z', or null if checked and on neither; absent if not checked (third-party repos are pinned by tag or SHA only).
